data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, even if others choose 10—not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of you: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next is 500 or 100. This risks future income, not a guaranteed long-run gain. Intentions aren't binding; other allocations need recalculation.
